Hi Emily — this is for a grand opening in November 2026. The month pillar changes with the solar terms: Wu-Xu from the 1st to the 6th, then Ji-Hai from the 7th (Start of Winter, 16:53) to the end of the month; the year is Bing-Wu. We work from your Jia-Xu year and its na yin element, Shan Tou Huo ("fire on the mountaintop"). Your branch Xu forms a Three Harmony with the year's Wu, which gives the whole year a supportive backdrop, and the Ji-Hai stretch is neutral for you. Chen days clash with Xu, so those are the ones to skip. The best picks are days whose branch harmonises with Xu (Mao for the Liu He pair; Yin and Wu for the Three Harmony) and whose element feeds your fire.

Here are the strongest windows by Four Pillars principles:

**[4 November 2026]** — Day pillar: Ren-Wu · Why: Wu completes the Three Harmony with your Xu, and it still falls in the Wu-Xu month — your own branch · Why it suits you: its na yin is Yang Liu Mu (wood), and wood feeds fire — a natural boost for a launch · Watch out: keep the ceremony to the morning; the afternoon is better for quiet setup.

**[12–13 November 2026]** — Day pillars: Geng-Yin, Xin-Mao · Why: Yin joins your Three Harmony and also pairs with the month's Hai (Liu He); Mao is your own Liu He partner · Why it suits you: both days are Song Bai Mu (pine wood), steady fuel for your fire — probably the best pair this month · Watch out: don't stack big supplier negotiations on the same day as the opening.

**[16 November 2026]** — Day pillar: Jia-Wu · Why: another Wu day in your Three Harmony · Why it suits you: Sha Zhong Jin (metal) is what your fire controls — traditionally read as wealth you can shape · Watch out: a good day for sales and promotions, less so for long-term contracts.

**[24–25 November 2026]** — Day pillars: Ren-Yin, Gui-Mao · Why: Yin and Mao again, so both harmonies line up, and Yin pairs with the month once more · Why it suits you: Jin Bo Jin (gold-leaf metal) brings the same "wealth" reading, in a lighter form · Watch out: end-of-month cash flow can be tight, so finish payments beforehand.

Days to avoid: the 2nd (Geng-Chen), 14th (Ren-Chen) and 26th (Jia-Chen) — Chen clashes with your Xu. Si days in the Ji-Hai stretch (the 15th and 27th) clash with the month and are best left alone too. These suggestions come from five-element and branch harmony/clash principles, not from a printed almanac, so check a traditional calendar for auspicious hours before you lock in a date. Wishing you a busy, prosperous opening!
